summary: Accepted after independent semantic re-review of WI #1942. The revision correctly separates immutable historical baseline provenance from the live three-run evaluation identity: baseline source_revision and baseline environment_fingerprint are retained and validated as capture metadata but are not required to equal current HEAD, while the verifier must independently observe the current revision and current-run environment fingerprint before run 1 and prove that both, the exact rustup rustc/cargo identities, and the manifest digest remain unchanged through run 3. This removes the impossible lifecycle self-reference without weakening intra-evaluation drift detection. The case still pins the independent 7,407-row denominator and digest, proves 13,767 whole-target and exact denominator-set-equal 7,407 filtered preflight names, requires each executed terminal set to equal the denominator with passed plus failed exactly 7,407 and filtered-out exactly 6,360, compares all three failure sets and counts exactly, bounds failures to the historical baseline allowed set/count, runs missing-result and outcome-flip canaries, and fails closed on incomplete accounting, drift, crash, timeout, truncation, missing evidence, or parse errors.
